confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Lisbon prices. The price sources were mostly crowd-sourced aggregators (Numbeo figures via Expatica, Hikersbay, CityCost and Expatistan) plus travel and bar guides. They gave about EUR 2.30-2.80 for a cappuccino, about EUR 3.00-3.13 for a 0.5 L draught beer, about EUR 13-15 for an inexpensive meal, about EUR 9-12 for a cocktail in Bairro Alto or Cais do Sodre bars, and about EUR 4-7 for a typical glass of wine. Only one source gave a mid-range meal for two, at about EUR 55. I raised that slightly for a three-course meal in a tourist area. Euros were converted at about 1.10 USD/EUR, worked out from the RBA rates for 18 Nov 2026 (0.6720 USD and 0.6115 EUR per AUD). Accommodation figures are model estimates for July high season from general knowledge only. I did not search or look at any booking listings. Lisbon summer room rates swing a lot by neighbourhood and date, so the four accommodation anchors are the least certain. Drink prices also run noticeably higher in rooftop, hotel and tourist-centre venues.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed for food and drink because direct Lisbon aggregate prices were available. For accommodation, the estimates are set in line with other popular Southern European capitals in peak season, such as Madrid and Barcelona. Lisbon is placed slightly below Barcelona and around Madrid's level.
